newsitem.title: USA: Belco buys 2.94 mln Hugoton shrs.
newsitem.headline: Belco buys 2.94 mln Hugoton shrs.

text.p: Belco Oil & Gas Corp said Friday it had purchased 2.94 million shares of Hugoton Energy Corp at $10.50 per share from affiliates of First Reserve Corp.
The stock represents about 14.9 percent of Hugoton's outstanding shares, Belco said.
It also said it had executed a joint confidentiality agreement with Hugoton for the exchange of information.
Belco said that "there are no assurances that a business combination transaction will occur" with Hugoton.
A Belco spokeswoman declined to elaborate.
